json.title: Where The Light Touched
json.dedication: For all of us, through the cold days.

pages.heading: Somewhere On The Road
pages.text: The light stays flat under the clouds as the road climbs higher into the hills. Nobody remembers pull-outs like this one, only the grey slope and the winter scrub passing outside.

pages.heading: On The Gravel Verge
pages.text: It is freezing out on the shoulder. You stand by the steep pine slope with your arms folded, keeping your hands tucked deep into your sleeves the whole time.

pages.heading: Clouds In The Valley
pages.text: We stop at the drop-off and watch in silence. The valley fills slowly with cloud beneath us while the very top of the sky turns warm.

pages.heading: Three Days Waiting
pages.text: We stand close together at the roadside railing, shivering in our heavy coats. After three days of waiting, the whole snow range finally comes out to catch the first light.

pages.heading: The Last Morning
pages.text: The low buildings sit quiet along the slope in the soft, early light. This is the last morning before the drive back down.
